manuscript.title: The Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture

main_result.statement: There exist homogeneous elements σ_(2k+1) in W_(2k+1) for every k>=1 for which the free rational Lie algebra on odd-weight generators maps isomorphically to the solution space W with the Ihara bracket; weight completions induce a continuous graded isomorphism.

proof.summary: Use dimension upper bound, constructed integral generators and Hall-basis independence to show freeness and spanning, W's bracket closure, then degreewise extension to the weight completion.
